backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Report listing implemented frontend features with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining theme variables, light/dark mode tokens, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading fonts, metadata, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the ReferencePage as the sole application view.
frontend/src/components/allende/AllendeS: Empty placeholder file for Allende page section components.
frontend/src/components/CoffeeFooter.tsx: Multi-column footer with branding, links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/CoffeeTopNav.tsx: Responsive top navigation bar with scrolling behavior and mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/scnned/ScnnedSec: Collection of Scnned landing-page sections including hero, features, and showcase components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, including loading stored identities and handling login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend data operations are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, CSS variables, Tailwind layers, and light/dark theme tokens for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CoffeeLandingPage.tsx: Renders the coffee-themed landing page layout using navigation, feature sections, showcase, and footer components.
frontend/src/pages/ReferencePage.tsx: Displays a centered reference number over a styled background with a button linking to an external document.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Contains the project’s current state, scope notes, requirements, and metadata for the minimal single-page redesign.
